entry_long: Source rule: L_entry1 with all conditions true window
entry_short: Source rule: S_entry1 with all conditions true window
exit: Source rule: L_exit1; order: strategy.close("Long", comment="Exit Early"); Source rule: S_exit1; order: strategy.close("Short", comment="Exit Early"); Source rule: strategy.opentrades.size(0)  exceeds  0; order: strategy.exit("Exit", "Long", limit=L_PT, stop=L_SL); Source rule: strategy.opentrades.size(0)  is below  0; order: strategy.exit("Exit", "Short", limit=S_PT, stop=S_SL)

position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Higher-timeframe/security or repaint behavior requires independent causal review.
